scripts.demo: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/demo start
scripts.demo:android: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/demo android
scripts.demo:ios: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/demo ios
scripts.storybook: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/storybook start
scripts.storybook:android: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/storybook android
scripts.storybook:ios: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/storybook ios
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck && tsc -p scripts
